## 简体中文

### 新增

- 重现 Windows 11 时钟与日历浮窗，支持导航动画、中国农历、节假日、系统日程和 Fluent 风格事件编辑器。
- 新增 Windows 11 风格快速设置和输入法面板，并为音频、电池、辅助功能及相关控件提供分页详情视图。
- 新增可配置 Windows 快捷键、Win+X 快速链接套件、独立分页设置窗口以及 Windows 风格的时钟和日期格式选项。
- 将第三方 macOS 状态项镜像到任务栏托盘，支持持久化溢出组织、可拖动系统项和 Windows 风格悬停标题。
- 新增 Windows 风格任务栏自动隐藏、显示桌面窄条行为和扩展的空白区域右键菜单。

### 修复

- 稳定窗口预览动画、尺寸、点击固定和 Aero Peek 切换，并减少不必要的缩略图与面板工作。
- 在后台增量刷新外部状态项，可靠转发组合状态项点击，并支持宽文本标签而无需应用专用适配。
- 自动隐藏时保留注意提醒；调整音量时自动取消静音；保留终端菜单项；并对齐 Windows 输入法切换行为。

## English

### Added

- Recreated the Windows 11 clock and calendar flyout with animated navigation, Chinese lunar dates, holidays, system events, and a Fluent-style event editor.
- Added Windows 11-style quick settings and input source panels with paged detail views for audio, battery, accessibility, and related controls.
- Added configurable Windows shortcut bindings, the Win+X quick-link suite, a standalone paged settings window, and Windows-style clock and date formatting options.
- Mirrored third-party macOS status items into the taskbar tray with persistent overflow organization, draggable system items, and Windows-style hover titles.
- Added Windows-style taskbar auto-hide, Show Desktop strip behavior, and an expanded empty-area context menu.

### Fixed

- Stabilized window preview animation, sizing, click pinning, and Aero Peek switching while reducing unnecessary thumbnail and panel work.
- Refreshed external status items incrementally off the main thread, forwarded composite item clicks reliably, and supported wide labels without app-specific handling.
- Preserved attention indicators while auto-hidden, unmuted audio when adjusting volume, retained terminal menu entries, and aligned Windows input-source switching behavior.
